entries.test: Whether the Technology Review interview with Bryan Johnson contains any skeptical questioning or any discussion of how his new religion would defend against risks from superintelligent AI.
entries.note: The quoted words describe what the Tech Review interview lacks (skepticism, discussion of defence against AI risk), but the proposition turns this into a claim that Johnson's religion has no substantive plan. As stated, it is a checkable observation about the article's content, not rhetoric.
